# 3M

> 3M applies science-driven innovation across diverse industries including automotive, safety, electronics, energy, manufacturing, and consumer products.

3M is a multinational corporation offering comprehensive product solutions and expertise across multiple market sectors. The site provides access to product catalogs, industry-specific solutions, brand directories, and corporate news.

## Key Topics

- 3M Science and Innovation
- Product Expertise Areas
- Safety Solutions and PPE
- Automotive Solutions
- Commercial Solutions
- Consumer Products
- Manufacturing and Abrasives
- Electronics Technology
- Energy Solutions
- Design and Construction
- Transportation Solutions
- Post-it Brand
- PELTOR Safety
- VHB Adhesives
- Collision Repair

## Core Products & Solutions

- [3M Homepage](https://www.3m.com): 3M homepage showcasing science-driven innovation across industries
- [All 3M Products](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p): Complete product catalog covering medical, industrial, and supply products
- [3M Brands Directory](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/company-us/our-brands): Complete directory of 3M brands including PELTOR, VHB, Bondo, Cubitron

## Industry Solutions

- [Safety Markets & Solutions](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/safety-us): Safety products and expertise: PPE, workplace, facility, road safety
- [Automotive Innovation](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/automotive-us): 3M automotive solutions for OEM, repair, and manufacturing sectors
- [Commercial Solutions](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/commercial-solutions-us): Commercial solutions for facility management, cleaning, and safety
- [Manufacturing Industries](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/manufacturing-us): Manufacturing solutions: abrasives, materials, bonding, metalworking
- [Electronics Technology](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/electronics-us): Electronics solutions for data centers, semiconductors, consumer devices
- [Energy Technology](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/energy-us): Energy solutions: connectors, tapes, fuel cells, renewable technologies
- [Design & Construction](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/design-construction-us): Design and construction products: VHB tapes, adhesives, architectural films
- [Transportation Solutions](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/transportation-us): Transportation solutions for aerospace, marine, rail, vehicle safety

## Market Segments

- [Consumer Products](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/consumer-us): Consumer products including Post-it and everyday household solutions
- [Automotive Care](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/auto-care-us): Auto care products for car maintenance, repair, and restoration
- [Collision Repair](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/collision-repair-us): Collision repair products and standard operating procedures for auto body
- [Automotive Manufacturing](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/automotive-manufacturing-and-assembly-us): Automotive manufacturing solutions for paint, masking, assembly processes
- [Government Solutions](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/government-us): Government solutions for federal, state, local agencies with NSN locator

## Company Information

- [3M Global Gateway](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/select-location): Global location selector for accessing regional 3M sites and products
- [3M News Center](https://news.3m.com/3M-stories): 3M company news, press releases, corporate announcements, innovation updates
